_general.text: The reviewer found about forty issues in the first drawing, none blocking: invented mesh measures, cis and trans reversed, KCl where only NaCl is validated, units in capitals, one-sided banners. All are fixed or answered; the record is docs/design/reviews/2026-10-25-choices.md.
Probes and cuts, selecting elements by quality, result tiles and the charge's link to residues are drawn before the library has them: REV-136.
